sahneler.metin: An airliner suddenly pitched down and dove into the Pacific.
The pilots fought it for minutes, but all eighty eight aboard died.
The tail's trim was driven by a single jackscrew.
Maintenance intervals had been stretched again and again.
The threads wore away until the nut could no longer hold.
The tail slipped, and the jet became uncontrollable.
Lubrication and wear checks were tightened across the fleet.

aciklama:
Alaska 261 dove into the Pacific Ocean. The cause: stripped acme nut threads on the horizontal stabilizer trim jackscrew.

#shorts #engineering #aviation

vaka.tetik: a jackscrew nut worn out by too little lubrication
vaka.mekanizma: stripped acme nut threads on the horizontal stabilizer trim jackscrew
vaka.ders: lubrication and end-play inspection intervals were tightened
vaka.yanilgi: The jackscrew didn't break suddenly. Its nut wore down over years because maintenance intervals had been stretched.
vaka.tartisma: Each extension of the maintenance interval looked small. How do small savings add up to a failure?
